segments.text: What if Rock Lee woke up with the Rinnegan? The character creator just lost its damn mind completely.
segments.label: THE BUILD IS ILLEGAL

segments.text: This is a fan-made upgrade, not canon. Lee gets gravity powers before he gets an instruction manual. Excellent parenting, universe.
segments.label: HYPOTHETICAL UPGRADE

segments.text: He tries a normal warm-up. The training weights fly toward his face. Brother ordered express shipping on his own concussion.
segments.label: THE FIRST ACCIDENT

segments.text: Guy says the power of youth requires control. Sir, your student just magnetized the furniture. Start with eye safety.
segments.label: GUY HAS CONCERNS

segments.text: Having the eyes wouldn't instantly teach every technique. Chakra demand and concentration still matter. Premium hardware, zero installed drivers.
segments.label: EYES ARE NOT A TUTORIAL

segments.text: Lee experiments with pulling opponents off balance before a kick. Strong idea. Horrific first day for the practice dummy.
segments.label: KICKS WITH CONSEQUENCES

segments.text: Then he realizes the harder lesson: when teammates stand nearby, a wild push can hurt the people he's protecting.
segments.label: THE RESTRAINT TEST

segments.text: So Guy sets a challenge. Move one falling leaf with the new power. Not the tree. Not the neighborhood.
segments.label: THAT IS THE REAL TRAINING

segments.text: Lee struggles because precision doesn't care how inspirational your speech sounds. The leaf remains deeply unimpressed by his grindset.
segments.label: ONE LEAF BRO

segments.text: He stops chasing the biggest attack and uses tiny pulls to create openings. The punches finally have a group chat.
segments.label: NO MAXIMUM POWER COMBO

segments.text: When a teammate falls, Lee catches them with controlled force instead of flexing. That rescue is the actual upgrade here.
segments.label: THE RESCUE MATTERS

segments.text: Guy cries with pride. Lee cries too. The leaf floats perfectly. Three episodes of training, and the final boss was landscaping.
segments.label: THE LEAF WINS
